cues.text: Finding a trading setup doesn’t have to start with hours of searching.
cues.shot: The app icon turns in 3D over the floor grid.

cues.text: Once you have the Options Traders Academy OS, save it directly to your phone or computer as a shortcut
cues.shot: The Q icon flies into the real iOS home row and lights up.

cues.text: so your trading system is always one click away.
cues.shot: PHONE · TABLET · DESKTOP.

cues.text: Log into your OTA OS and start inside your profile.
cues.shot: Real app: the Q header lights, then the profile card.

cues.text: From there, open Your Daily Play.
cues.shot: The PROFILE tab in the bottom nav lights.

cues.text: This is where you begin building your strategy.
cues.shot: PROFILE → YOUR DAILY PLAY.

cues.text: Enter the ticker you want to analyze and choose whether you’re looking for an options setup or a futures setup.
cues.shot: The Options / Futures toggle lights on the real dashboard.

cues.text: You decide what market you want to study.
cues.shot: QQQ types itself into the real ticker field.

cues.text: The OS helps you organize the analysis.
cues.shot: QQQ · SPY · AAPL · NVDA light up.

cues.text: Next, pull your charts from TradingView.
cues.shot: Five chart cards begin dealing in.

cues.text: Upload your full intraday view, four-hour, one-hour, fifteen-minute, and five-minute charts.
cues.shot: Each card lands as it is named.

cues.text: Those timeframes give the system the market structure it needs.
cues.shot: The five cards fly into the device.

cues.text: Once your charts are uploaded, OTA OS analyzes the information and builds your plan.
cues.shot: Scan passes: trend, support, resistance, structure.

cues.text: It may identify a bullish setup, a bearish setup — or tell you there’s no trade worth taking yet.
cues.shot: BULLISH · BEARISH · OR WAIT. The last one holds.

cues.text: Then read the full strategy.
cues.shot: The real trade plan scrolls.

cues.text: The system helps you identify the directional bias, important levels, confirmation, possible entry conditions, exits, and risk considerations.
cues.shot: Confirmation, entry, exit and stop light in turn.

cues.text: And when the better decision may simply be to sit on your hands.
cues.shot: BIAS · LEVELS · CONFIRMATION · ENTRY · EXIT · RISK.

cues.text: For options setups, continue through the analysis and review the contract or strike the system identifies.
cues.shot: PRIMARY STRIKE, then OTM RUNNER, on the real plan.

cues.text: Then open your brokerage platform — we use Robinhood —
cues.shot: OTA OS → YOUR BROKERAGE → WATCHLIST.

cues.text: find that contract, and add it to your watchlist.
cues.shot: The real home row again; the broker icon lights.

cues.text: And this part matters: a contract appearing on your screen does not mean you automatically buy it.
cues.shot: The contract sits on a watchlist. WATCHING — NOT BOUGHT.

cues.text: Watch the setup. Confirm the conditions. Review the contract yourself. Manage your risk.
cues.shot: The confirmation checklist ticks itself off.

cues.text: Then decide whether the opportunity fits your trading plan.
cues.shot: YOU DECIDE. NOT THE SCREEN.

cues.text: That’s how you use the Options Traders Academy OS to go from a ticker, to market analysis, to a structured trading plan.
cues.shot: Phone, tablet and desktop, each carrying a real screen.

cues.text: No technology can predict what the market will do next.
cues.shot: The line said plainly, in red.

cues.text: The advantage is having a system that helps you analyze the information, organize the setup, and make a more informed decision instead of guessing.
cues.shot: The edge is the system you use to decide.

cues.text: Because trading isn’t about trying to catch every move.
cues.shot: Deep green, going quiet. The mark holds, barely lit.

cues.text: It’s about having a strategy, waiting for confirmation, managing your risk, and using technology to build a stronger edge.
cues.shot: Strategy. Confirmation. Managed risk. A stronger edge.
